name: What bathroom upgrades matter most for resale in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What bathroom upgrades matter most for resale in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Pasadena, buyers often respond well to clean finishes, updated tile, good lighting, quality fixtures, and smart storage. A functional layout and a fresh, well-maintained look usually matter more than unusually bold design choices. If resale is a priority, aim for timeless materials and practical improvements instead of trendy features that may date quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: For Pasadena resale, focus on clean finishes, good lighting, updated fixtures, storage, and timeless materials.
